[size=4]Tired of running all the way across town just to buy seeds? [/size][/font][/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Delivery Service brings the convenience of online shopping right to your virtual pocket![/size][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[left]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Introduction:[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]This mod adds a fully interactive [b]Delivery Service[/b] app to your Smartphone, allowing you to buy items from anywhere in the Valley.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]Air delivery - a hot air balloon will deliver your order to your requested location.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]Shop customize - work with any shops, and you can customize its name and owner as well.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][color=#f1c232][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][url=https://ibb.co/hRBWRLSt]
[/url][/size][/font][/color]
[center][img width=800]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49000/49000-1784454536-1691518692.png[/img][/center]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]How thing works:[/size][/color][/font][/left]
[left][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#f1c232]Visited shop will appear in the list (you need to revisit after install for it to shows up). Delivery time is based on distance between the shop and the drop location.[/color][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#f1c232]Recipe are not purchasable and will not listed in the app. Only regular items.[/color][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#f1c232]Fully support modded shops/items. Certain shops/items are not suppose to be there (festival shops...), which you can use Edit mode/Config to hide it if you want.[/color][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#f1c232]If you are at the same location when delivery arrive, look out for the balloon.[/color][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#f1c232]You may [b]not [/b]want to purchase "iregular items" from "iregular shops" (Clint's upgrade for example). IDK what gonna happen.[/color][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][color=#f1c232]Can work with catalogue as well. Enable it in Config.[/color][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][/left]
